prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image supplies ONLY character identity and pixel-art style, not pose. Make a completely NEW transparent sprite animation master, 20 full-body sprites arranged uniformly as 4 horizontal rows, 5 columns. A mechanically accurate climbing loop is the main objective.
CRITICAL VIEW: strictly FROM BEHIND, centered on the SPINE. NO faces visible. Both shoulders, both hands, both knees and both feet clearly visible on opposite sides of the spine, symmetric body construction, shoulders upright, same body size and central pelvis in all cells. Hands ABOVE HEAD in every frame. This is climbing, never walking or a fighting stance.
Character A: slim female ranger, long RED ponytail, emerald green tunic, short green cape, brown belt and tall brown boots.
Character B: male knight with brown hair, SILVER plate armor and short SAPPHIRE BLUE cape, gold belt.
ROW 1: character A climbing an invisible vertical LADDER. Row 3: character B doing the same.
Five ladder phases across each row, in order:
1 LEFT hand HIGH and RIGHT knee HIGH, opposite limbs extended.
2 left hand starts pulling body, right foot starts stepping down, both knees slightly bent.
3 RIGHT hand HIGH and LEFT knee HIGH, opposite limbs extended. This MUST be the clearly mirrored limb configuration of column 1.
4 right hand starts pulling, left foot stepping down, knees slightly bent.
5 approaching column 1, left arm rising and right knee bending.
Ladder hands spread at shoulder width. All hands stay above the head. Torso stays centered. The body does NOT move upward within the frame.
ROW 2: character A climbing an invisible ROPE; row 4 character B climbing rope. Same five alternating phases but BOTH hands are CLOSE TOGETHER ABOVE THE HEAD on a central vertical line; knees pull in and legs brace to grip center rope, then extend during pull. Switch which hand is on top halfway through. Clearly different limb poses from ladder.
Exact character identities, simple readable pixel anatomy, consistent crisp pixel size, dark outlines, no gradients, no glow. Standalone animated game figures with large real alpha margins between cells. No ladder, rope, weapon, shield, text, labels, grid, shadows or environment. Never use an armed side-facing combat pose.
review: Rear-view climbing with alternating arms and knees. Ladder hands stay apart; rope hands meet above the head. Source alpha is preserved; runtime exports use nearest-neighbor scaling.
